fit.gap_handling_summary: The documents accurately foreground production NLP, Azure deployment, monitoring and complaint classification. They clearly distinguish encoder-model fine-tuning from the candidate's limited generative-LLM experience and label the RAG work as a personal prototype. Four years specifically shipping production ML as an ML engineer are not established, and no completed qualifying degree is documented. Pipeline ownership, data versioning, CI/CD, testing, cost evaluation and cross-team engineering remain unsubstantiated rather than fabricated.

issues: There is no email address, telephone number or professional profile link. None was supplied, so inventing them would not have been appropriate, but the CV is not contact-ready.
The education section correctly describes an unfinished doctorate but does not establish an awarded qualifying degree; the supplied material does not provide one.
The summary and personal-project section repeat the lack of production LLM experience and LLM fine-tuning. One clear qualification would be sufficient.
The second page is only 28% filled, making the two-page presentation inefficient.

reasons: The single-column PDF extracts in a sensible order and uses recognisable section headings.
Production deployment, cloud experience, Python, MLflow and measurable model results provide substantial technical matching.
Coverage includes semantic equivalents: LLM for language models and accuracy/F1 for model evaluation.
TF-IDF provides supported feature-engineering evidence, but that keyword is not explicit.
A strict four-year production-ML-engineering filter or completed-degree filter may reject the application.
Several engineering-process and pipeline keywords are absent; the supplied material does not justify adding most of them.
RAG and LLM terms are present, but their surrounding text correctly identifies prototype-only experience.

issues: Much of the letter repeats the CV's metrics and technical narrative rather than adding a distinct contribution argument.
The company-specific motivation accurately names Quillstone's values, but does not develop a concrete connection to small merchants or a particular support workflow.
The paragraph beginning with the earlier banking role combines banking, RAG and doctoral research and could be more focused.
strengths: Names the correct company and exact role.
Connects document classification and complaint analysis to ticket routing and support-agent assistance.
Uses credible production scale, evaluation results and a monitoring incident as evidence.
Accurately describes RAG as prototype-stage work.
Uses ownership, teamwork and learning from mistakes from the supplied company information.
Does not reuse the old application's employer, outdated current-job statement or local-work motivation.

spacing_issues: The CV's first page is comparatively dense, while page two contains only education, certification and three short contribution bullets.
The CV's second page is only 28% filled and leaves most of the page empty.
The long selected-project heading forces its date onto a separate line, unlike the right-aligned dates elsewhere.
issues: The skills section is a dense semicolon-separated block and would scan faster if grouped by function.
Several experience bullets contain multiple technical details and metrics, making the first page visually busy.
The shared serif typography makes the documents look related, although the letter uses a simpler presentation.

fluency_and_tone_issues: "Work includes document classification serving approximately 15,000 documents per day" is slightly awkward; it is the classification service or system that processes the documents.

"LLM experience is limited to a personal weekend RAG prototype; no production LLM work or LLM fine-tuning" is candid but disproportionately defensive in the summary, especially because the limitation is repeated under the project.

notes_facts_used: The doctorate is unfinished and expected in 2027; no doctoral title is claimed.
LLM experience is limited to the weekend RAG demo, with no production LLM work or LLM fine-tuning.
Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate, obtained in 2024.
Guest lecture at an NLP summer school in 2025, lasting 90 minutes.
Regular English meetings with a Slovenian client.
The preference to remain in NLP/document AI is reflected in the positioning and selected experience.

evaluation.summary: The documents are accurate, technically credible and well targeted to production NLP and customer-support classification, with strong deployment, evaluation and monitoring evidence. They correctly preserve the unfinished doctorate and distinguish the personal RAG demo from professional production work. The application still does not establish four years specifically as a production ML engineer, an awarded qualifying degree, or several required engineering-process and pipeline capabilities. The main presentation weaknesses are missing contact details, repeated negative LLM framing and an inefficient, mostly empty second CV page.
